final: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS region_count FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), totals AS (SELECT SUM(region_count) AS total_count, AVG(region_count) AS average_count FROM region_counts) SELECT SUM(r.region_count) AS total_kept_count, AVG(1.0 * r.region_count / t.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(r.region_count - t.average_count) AS average_excess FROM region_counts AS r CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL AND t.average_count IS NOT NULL AND r.region_count > t.average_count
